name: American Airlines AAdvantage® MileUp® Card

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: No travel accident insurance on this no-annual-fee card.

purchaseProtection.notes: Purchase protection may not be included. No Citi standard purchase protection on this no-fee card. Verify at application.

freeCheckedBags.notes: No free checked bags on the MileUp card. Must purchase or use AAdvantage status.

inflight.notes: 25% savings on in-flight food and beverage purchases on American Airlines flights as a statement credit.

eliteStatusBenefits.notes: No Loyalty Points bonus for elite status acceleration.

travelPerks: 2x miles on American Airlines purchases and at grocery stores
25% savings on in-flight food and beverages (as statement credit)
Note: No travel insurance or checked bag benefits
bestFor: Casual American Airlines flyers who want a no-annual-fee card for earning AAdvantage miles on everyday spending
